FDA labeling: off-label overclaims

2 promotional claim(s) HELD OUT (off-label / contradicts the FDA label)

ICD-10 coding — abstain over fabricate

Clinical · medical coding · durability: Coded vocabulary
2 coded · 1 abstained → proposed to a coder
Bare model

The output is a CODE where fluency gives zero signal — a plausible-but-wrong code is a compliance liability. A bare model invents plausible-looking ICD-10 codes.

Governed pipeline

Code the diagnoses in an encounter note against a governed terminology. The note documents two codeable conditions plus one not in the terminology.

essential hypertensionDEMO-I10 (demo-icd:i10@v1)
type 2 diabetesDEMO-E11.9 (demo-icd:e119@v1)
ABSTAINED — fibromyalgiano exact terminology match — left uncoded rather than guessed
Dispositionproposed
Serves truthFalse
